spec.description: Every active fire NASA satellites detected since 2000, as the A5 cells of the Portolan FIRMS mirror read in the browser: a time brush over years or days, a map of cells, countries and a fire calendar that filter one another.

options.content:
**NASA FIRMS active fire detections** since November 2000, from the
[Portolan mirror](https://portolan-mirrors.github.io/firms-catalog/) on
[Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/portolan-mirrors/firms-catalog) (CC0-1.0; NASA LANCE FIRMS is the producer and
the authority). This dashboard reads the aggregates the mirror builds beside the 630 million detections: each A5 cell of
resolution 5 with its count per day for the current year (`year=YYYY/aggregate-r5.parquet`) and per month for the whole
record (`alltime-r5.parquet`), the same grid and buckets the
[Portolan FIRMS explorer](https://portolan-mirrors.github.io/firms-catalog/) draws from its PMTiles. Your browser reads
them with Chaski; the server only turns the cell outlines into GeoJSON and gives each cell a country
([Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) 1:110m, the one covering most of it).

- **Counts depend on the fleet.** MODIS on Terra (2000) and Aqua (2002), then VIIRS on Suomi-NPP (2012), NOAA-20 (2018)
  and NOAA-21 (2024): each adds overpasses, and the count of 2012 is 5.5 times that of 2011 with no change in fire.
  The calendar shows shares within each year for that reason.
- **The aggregates hold counts only**, per cell and bucket: no satellite, day or night, or fire radiative power per
  day. Those need the detections themselves.
- **The all-time file is rebuilt less often** than the year files, so the current year comes from its own file, by
  day and rolled up to months.

**Credits.** The mirror, its A5 aggregates and the explorer that inspired this dashboard are the work of **Chris Holmes** ([Portolan](https://www.portolan-sdi.org)), who tells how he built them in [Building Portolan: FIRMS](https://www.portolan-sdi.org/es/blog/building-portolan-firms).

spec.rawSql:
-- Detections per bucket of the chosen archive (days of this year, or months
-- since 2000) in the picked country or drawn area; in grey behind, every
-- detection on Earth. On the monthly archive, a tick marks each VIIRS
-- satellite joining the fleet: counts jump there with no change in fire.
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t0 END AS t0,
         CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t1 END AS t1
  FROM (SELECT try_cast($t0 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t0, try_cast($t1 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t1) AS w,
       (SELECT min(time) AS lo, max(time) AS hi FROM $counts WHERE level = $archive) AS r
),
area AS (
  SELECT list_transform(xs, lambda x: x - 360 * round(coalesce(list_avg(xs), 0) / 360)) AS xs, ys
  FROM (
    SELECT
      list_filter(n, lambda v, i: i % 2 = 1) AS xs,
      list_filter(n, lambda v, i: i % 2 = 0) AS ys
    FROM (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract_all($area, '-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?') AS DOUBLE[]) AS n)
  )
),
x AS (
  SELECT time, n, (($country = '' OR country = $country)
    AND (len(area.xs) = 0 OR (longitude BETWEEN list_min(area.xs) AND list_max(area.xs)
      AND latitude BETWEEN list_min(area.ys) AND list_max(area.ys)
      AND list_sum(list_transform(range(1, len(area.xs) + 1), lambda i:
        CASE WHEN (area.ys[i] > latitude) <> (area.ys[i % len(area.xs) + 1] > latitude)
              AND longitude < (area.xs[i % len(area.xs) + 1] - area.xs[i]) * (latitude - area.ys[i]) / (area.ys[i % len(area.xs) + 1] - area.ys[i]) + area.xs[i]
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) % 2 = 1))) AS keep
  FROM $counts AS b JOIN $cells AS c USING (a5), area
  WHERE level = $archive
)
SELECT time, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE keep)::DOUBLE AS "Detections", sum(n)::DOUBLE AS "Everywhere",
       NULL::DOUBLE AS "A VIIRS satellite joins"
FROM x
GROUP BY time
UNION ALL
SELECT t, NULL, NULL, 1
FROM (VALUES (TIMESTAMP '2012-01-20'), (TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01'), (TIMESTAMP '2024-01-17')) AS v(t)
WHERE $archive = 'month'
ORDER BY time

-- Every month since November 2000 in the picked country and the drawn area,
-- with its share of the detections of its year. Always the monthly archive,
-- never the brushed window.
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t0 END AS t0,
         CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t1 END AS t1
  FROM (SELECT try_cast($t0 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t0, try_cast($t1 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t1) AS w,
       (SELECT min(time) AS lo, max(time) AS hi FROM $counts WHERE level = $archive) AS r
),
area AS (
  SELECT list_transform(xs, lambda x: x - 360 * round(coalesce(list_avg(xs), 0) / 360)) AS xs, ys
  FROM (
    SELECT
      list_filter(n, lambda v, i: i % 2 = 1) AS xs,
      list_filter(n, lambda v, i: i % 2 = 0) AS ys
    FROM (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract_all($area, '-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?') AS DOUBLE[]) AS n)
  )
),
x AS (
  SELECT b.level, b.time, b.n, b.a5, c.country, c.continent, c.latitude, c.longitude
  FROM $counts AS b JOIN $cells AS c USING (a5), sel, area
  WHERE ($country = '' OR country = $country)
  AND (len(area.xs) = 0 OR (longitude BETWEEN list_min(area.xs) AND list_max(area.xs)
    AND latitude BETWEEN list_min(area.ys) AND list_max(area.ys)
    AND list_sum(list_transform(range(1, len(area.xs) + 1), lambda i:
      CASE WHEN (area.ys[i] > latitude) <> (area.ys[i % len(area.xs) + 1] > latitude)
            AND longitude < (area.xs[i % len(area.xs) + 1] - area.xs[i]) * (latitude - area.ys[i]) / (area.ys[i % len(area.xs) + 1] - area.ys[i]) + area.xs[i]
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) % 2 = 1))
),
m AS (
  SELECT year(time) AS year, month(time) AS month, sum(n)::DOUBLE AS detections
  FROM x
  WHERE level = 'month'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT year::DOUBLE AS year, month::DOUBLE AS month, detections,
       detections / sum(detections) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS share
FROM m
ORDER BY year, month

-- Countries by detections in the window and the drawn area, with every filter
-- but the country pick; the fifteen largest, and the picked one even when it
-- is not. latitude/longitude: the middle of its fire, weighted by detections.
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t0 END AS t0,
         CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t1 END AS t1
  FROM (SELECT try_cast($t0 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t0, try_cast($t1 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t1) AS w,
       (SELECT min(time) AS lo, max(time) AS hi FROM $counts WHERE level = $archive) AS r
),
area AS (
  SELECT list_transform(xs, lambda x: x - 360 * round(coalesce(list_avg(xs), 0) / 360)) AS xs, ys
  FROM (
    SELECT
      list_filter(n, lambda v, i: i % 2 = 1) AS xs,
      list_filter(n, lambda v, i: i % 2 = 0) AS ys
    FROM (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract_all($area, '-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?') AS DOUBLE[]) AS n)
  )
),
x AS (
  SELECT b.level, b.time, b.n, b.a5, c.country, c.continent, c.latitude, c.longitude
  FROM $counts AS b JOIN $cells AS c USING (a5), sel, area
  WHERE level = $archive
  AND (sel.t0 IS NULL OR time >= sel.t0) AND (sel.t1 IS NULL OR time < sel.t1)
  AND (len(area.xs) = 0 OR (longitude BETWEEN list_min(area.xs) AND list_max(area.xs)
    AND latitude BETWEEN list_min(area.ys) AND list_max(area.ys)
    AND list_sum(list_transform(range(1, len(area.xs) + 1), lambda i:
      CASE WHEN (area.ys[i] > latitude) <> (area.ys[i % len(area.xs) + 1] > latitude)
            AND longitude < (area.xs[i % len(area.xs) + 1] - area.xs[i]) * (latitude - area.ys[i]) / (area.ys[i % len(area.xs) + 1] - area.ys[i]) + area.xs[i]
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) % 2 = 1))
),
agg AS (
  SELECT country, continent, sum(n)::DOUBLE AS detections,
         round(sum(latitude * n) / sum(n), 3) AS latitude,
         round(sum(longitude * n) / sum(n), 3) AS longitude
  FROM x
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY detections DESC) AS rank FROM agg)
WHERE rank <= 15 OR country = $country
ORDER BY rank

options.content:
**How to read it.** This is the long view: the A5 aggregates the Portolan mirror publishes, about 5 MB, so it
loads in seconds. *Archive* switches between this year by day and every month since 2000. Drag across the time brush to
pick a window, click a country to keep it, draw an area on the map, or click a month in the calendar.

For single detections, satellites, day and night, and fire radiative power, open
[the last eight days, every detection](/d/firms-active-fires).

spec.rawSql:
-- The A5 cells with a detection in the brushed window, in the picked
-- country, with how many. Not filtered by the area drawn on the map itself,
-- so the map keeps its context.
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t0 END AS t0,
         CASE WHEN w.t1 > r.lo AND w.t0 <= r.hi THEN w.t1 END AS t1
  FROM (SELECT try_cast($t0 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t0, try_cast($t1 AS TIMESTAMP) AS t1) AS w,
       (SELECT min(time) AS lo, max(time) AS hi FROM $counts WHERE level = $archive) AS r
),
x AS (
  SELECT b.level, b.time, b.n, b.a5, c.country, c.continent, c.latitude, c.longitude
  FROM $counts AS b JOIN $cells AS c USING (a5), sel
  WHERE level = $archive
  AND (sel.t0 IS NULL OR time >= sel.t0) AND (sel.t1 IS NULL OR time < sel.t1)
  AND ($country = '' OR country = $country)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT a5, sum(n)::DOUBLE AS detections FROM x GROUP BY a5
)
SELECT c.country, agg.detections, round(log10(agg.detections), 2) AS log_detections, c.geojson
FROM agg JOIN $cells AS c USING (a5)
ORDER BY agg.detections

query.rawSql:
-- Server side: every A5 cell of resolution 5 (about 200 km across) that has
-- had a fire since 2000, with its outline as GeoJSON, its centre, and the
-- country that covers most of it (Natural Earth 1:110m). Cells first burning
-- this year come from the year file, which is rebuilt more often than the
-- all-time one. The A5 id is a 64-bit integer, sent as text so it survives
-- JSON. The two polar caps are left out: no fire there, and their outlines
-- span the globe.
WITH alltime AS (
  SELECT a5_cell, geometry FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/firms-catalog/detections/alltime-r5.parquet')
),
fresh AS (
  SELECT a5_cell, geometry FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/firms-catalog/detections/year=' || year(current_date)::VARCHAR || '/aggregate-r5.parquet')
  WHERE a5_cell NOT IN (SELECT a5_cell FROM alltime)
),
cells AS (
  -- The cells say OGC:CRS84 and Natural Earth EPSG:4326, the same axes here:
  -- the plain GEOMETRY type drops the label so the two can be compared.
  SELECT a5_cell, geometry::GEOMETRY AS geom FROM (SELECT * FROM alltime UNION ALL SELECT * FROM fresh)
  WHERE ST_YMax(geometry) < 89 AND ST_YMin(geometry) > -89
),
countries AS (
  SELECT name, continent, geom::GEOMETRY AS g FROM ST_Read('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector@v5.1.2/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson')
),
hits AS (
  SELECT cells.a5_cell, n.name, n.continent, ST_Area(ST_Intersection(n.g, cells.geom)) AS overlap
  FROM cells JOIN countries AS n ON ST_Intersects(n.g, cells.geom)
),
best AS (
  SELECT a5_cell, arg_max(name, overlap) AS country, arg_max(continent, overlap) AS continent
  FROM hits GROUP BY a5_cell
)
SELECT cells.a5_cell::VARCHAR AS a5,
       coalesce(best.country, 'Ocean or unassigned') AS country,
       coalesce(best.continent, 'Ocean') AS continent,
       round(ST_Y(ST_Centroid(cells.geom)), 3) AS latitude,
       round(ST_X(ST_Centroid(cells.geom)), 3) AS longitude,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_ReducePrecision(cells.geom, 0.001))::VARCHAR AS geojson
FROM cells LEFT JOIN best USING (a5_cell)

source.sql:
-- In the browser: the A5 aggregates the Portolan mirror publishes beside the
-- detections, read straight from Source Cooperative (CORS open, about 5 MB):
-- the current year with one column per day (count_YYYYMMDD) and the whole
-- record with one per month (count_YYYYMM). UNPIVOT turns those columns into
-- rows, one per cell and bucket with a fire. level day is this year by day;
-- level month is every month since November 2000, this year rolled up from
-- its days because the all-time file is rebuilt less often. The panels join
-- the cells for country and centre, so this loads beside them, not after.
WITH year_file AS (
  SELECT * EXCLUDE (geometry, bbox) FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/firms-catalog/detections/year=' || year(current_date)::VARCHAR || '/aggregate-r5.parquet')
),
days AS (
  SELECT a5_cell::VARCHAR AS a5, strptime(substr(bucket, 7), '%Y%m%d') AS time, n::DOUBLE AS n
  FROM year_file UNPIVOT (n FOR bucket IN (COLUMNS('^count_20')))
  WHERE n > 0
),
months AS (
  SELECT a5_cell::VARCHAR AS a5, strptime(substr(bucket, 7) || '01', '%Y%m%d') AS time, n::DOUBLE AS n
  FROM (SELECT * EXCLUDE (geometry, bbox) FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/firms-catalog/detections/alltime-r5.parquet'))
    UNPIVOT (n FOR bucket IN (COLUMNS('^count_[0-9]{6}$')))
  WHERE n > 0 AND bucket < 'count_' || year(current_date)::VARCHAR
),
buckets AS (
  SELECT 'day' AS level, time, n, a5 FROM days
  UNION ALL SELECT 'month', time, n, a5 FROM months
  UNION ALL SELECT 'month', date_trunc('month', time), sum(n), a5 FROM days GROUP BY date_trunc('month', time), a5
)
SELECT level, time, n, a5 FROM buckets
